subject: assets
title: The asset studio: stage, shot sets and the taste loop
note: First captures of the M4 asset studio: Sepulcra's recipes on the isolated stage (neutral, game and worst-light rigs, a 1.8 m figure and 1 m cube), the five-shot set at true pixel size, a turntable with value and silhouette passes, a line-up with silhouette distinctness, and a studio_check that catches a drafted bone pile (raw brown reads as reserved fire, too small from the game camera, over budget) and passes its revision. Previous entries showed recipes in a moonlit world scene only.
